title: Source Authority and Canonical 25-Profile Index
authority_rule: PPIA-06 morphology profiles are the canonical 25-profile appearance set; PPIA-05 remains biology truth and PPIA-03 remains actual equipment authority.

profiles.visual_summary: Familiar humanoid body with highly diverse body types, facial features, skin tones and hair across the Many Earths.
Slender graceful humanoid with refined angular features, high cheekbones, slightly pointed ears and almond-shaped eyes; some lineages show shimmer/glow or unusual mineral hair tones.
Stout, sturdy humanoid with powerful shoulders/limbs; Heimenhearth examples can show metallic skin undertones and gem-like eyes.
special_customizer_behavior: beard controls available regardless of sex; do not hard-lock by gender
owner_canon_decisions: Beard morphology is available regardless of sex and is not hard gender-locked. Mild dimorphism generally uses optional presets/ranges rather than mandatory gender gates.

profiles.visual_summary: Small wiry impish/gaunt humanoid with green, gray or yellowish skin, large yellow-to-red eyes, pointed ears and sharp teeth.
Large muscular broad-shouldered humanoid with gray-green/gray/black skin, pronounced brow, wide upturned nose and strong jaws.
special_customizer_behavior: visible tusks are optional and usually not prominent
owner_canon_decisions: Lower canine/tusk structures are optional in visible presentation; most Orcs do not show prominent tusks.

profiles.visual_summary: Very large muscular humanoid with luminous eyes, lineage-specific skin/material cues and rune-like markings.
bounded_variation: Grendelkin: mossy green/gray, rough barklike textures
Surtrborn: red/obsidian skin with molten glow and firelike hair
Daityr: bronze/gold metallic sheen and fierce luminous eyes
special_customizer_behavior: only Grendelkin, Surtrborn and Daityr are valid appearance lineages; legacy Skyborn/Stoneborn/Flameborn labels are not additional lineages
owner_canon_decisions: Canonical lineages are Grendelkin, Surtrborn and Daityr. Skyborn/Stoneborn/Flameborn in example NPC prose are naming errors and must not become additional appearance lineages.

profiles.visual_summary: Mostly human-looking compact humanoid with dark charcoal/ashy skin, luminous eyes, demonic horns/tail, clawlike nails and optional wings.
bounded_variation: hair commonly black/deep red but presentation may follow resolved source bounds
special_customizer_behavior: do not use pointed ears from concept art
wing appearance cannot grant flight; wings may be functional or vestigial
owner_canon_decisions: Concept-art visual direction is canonical except pointed ears are not. Stygians otherwise look mostly human apart from dark/ashy skin, horns and other explicitly authorized demonic traits. Tails are canonical; horns are optional and broadly variable; wings occur sometimes.
Optional wings may be functional or vestigial/nonfunctional; appearance never grants flight mechanics.

studio_profile_behavior.rule: wing appearance never grants flight; functional/vestigial status comes from upstream state

profiles.visual_summary: Human-adjacent but broader and more muscular, with proportionally larger cranium and robust Neanderthal-associated facial morphology.
owner_canon_decisions: Sharr visibly include robust Neanderthal-associated facial morphology such as heavy brow, broad nose and robust facial structure.

profiles.visual_summary: Slender lightweight gray humanoid with long thin limbs, four elongated fingers with round pads, enlarged elongated skull, high forehead, tiny jaw, large black almond eyes, no external ears and minimal mouth/nose structures.
owner_canon_decisions: Canonical height is 4 to 5 feet. Grays are hairless, effectively earless, and have minimal nose structure.

profiles.visual_summary: Sentient mechanical humanoid; original prose favors silvery alloy, glowing eyes, elegant segmentation and etched patterns, while owner canon broadens the allowed humanoid android grammar substantially.
bounded_variation: glowing/illuminated optics optional within design grammar
special_customizer_behavior: not arbitrary quadruped/floating/nonhumanoid topology
mechanical replacement hardware and real augmentations are mechanics-owned
owner_canon_decisions: The Free support an extremely broad range of humanoid android designs, not arbitrary nonhumanoid topology. Etched/presentation patterns may be player-authored; actual replacement hardware/augmentations remain mechanics-owned.

studio_profile_behavior.rule: very broad humanoid android grammar; actual replacement hardware remains mechanics-owned

profiles.visual_summary: Small lean furred rodent humanoid with sharp rodent features, large expressive eyes, rounded ears, whiskers, narrow snout, clawed fingers, padded feet and long prehensile tail.
Small agile mouse-like humanoid with soft consciously mutable fur, sensitive ears/snouts and a tail.
bounded_variation: up to three simultaneous fur colors
special_customizer_behavior: fur phenotype changes are biological appearance controls and may also communicate/camouflage; separate current visual state from saved preferred state when mechanics require
owner_canon_decisions: Furashin are more mouse-related than rat-related and have tails. They have full conscious fur control over color, pattern and texture, with up to three colors simultaneously.

studio_profile_behavior.rule: up to three colors plus pattern/texture; filename labels on reference art do not define Species

profiles.visual_summary: Stocky porcine humanoid descended from tusked subterranean Rog, with inherent pig/boar facial features.
bounded_variation: tusks and tusk adornment/markings within source
owner_canon_decisions: Rog have inherent porcine features in addition to the source-backed stocky/tusked morphology.

profiles.visual_summary: Humanoid cockroach-like species with segmented hardened exoskeleton, large glossy compound eyes, long antennae and hooked claws; highly flexible segmented body.
bounded_variation: dark brown to jet black baseline with iridescence

profiles.visual_summary: Humanoid ant species with segmented chitinous body, one pair of arms plus two pairs of legs, compound eyes, antennae and mandibles.
special_customizer_behavior: renderer must support six-limb bipedal/insectoid anchor set; never collapse second leg pair or invent humanoid two-leg topology

studio_profile_behavior.rule: never collapse to two-leg humanoid layout

profiles.visual_summary: Wasp-like upright insectoid with four arms, two legs, compound eyes, antennae, gossamer wings, prominent abdomen and stinger; hand-drawn concept controls where prose says two arms.
bounded_variation: subtle source-backed dimorphism without hard role locks
special_customizer_behavior: owner concept supersedes PDF two-arm sentence
owner_canon_decisions: Canonical anatomy is four arms and two legs. Hand-drawn Vespin art is the closest visual authority, including the prominent wasp abdomen/stinger structure.

studio_profile_behavior.rule: wardrobe/equipment variants must support four-arm anchors or report unsupported

profiles.visual_summary: Small reptilian kobold-evolution with scales, hardened beak, long tail, swept-back ears and actual black facial feathers arranged roughly as a raven-shaped marking.
bounded_variation: gray/green scale families and source-valid patterns
special_customizer_behavior: no horns; hornlike shapes in older Kobold concept are noncanonical
owner_canon_decisions: Rakuuta are an evolution/cousin line of kobolds. IMG_20240811_115259 is the closest visual reference. They do not have horns; the swept-back structures are ears. The black facial marking is made of actual black feathers arranged roughly in a raven shape.

studio_profile_behavior.rule: swept-back structures are ears, not horns

profiles.visual_summary: Lean raptor-descended biped with two arms, two legs, long semi-prehensile tail, large expressive eyes and clawed hands/feet.
bounded_variation: lineage adaptations such as webbing/gills/reflective patches
special_customizer_behavior: no independent extra wing pair in base topology
owner_canon_decisions: Canonical base plan is two arms, two legs and a tail. Winglike traits are forearm feathering/gliding structures or source-authorized adaptations, not an extra wing pair. Source-valid characters may range freely across feathered, scaled and mixed presentation where their variant permits.

profiles.visual_summary: Aquatic/fishlike humanoid with slick bluish-green skin, large eyes, needle teeth, neck gills, webbed digits, spinal fin ridge and owner-canonical tail/fins from the hand-drawn baseline concept.
special_customizer_behavior: Bioengineering Forms are separate source-owned Form state; do not promote Form anatomy into baseline
owner_canon_decisions: The hand-drawn aquatic/fishlike concept is baseline Kola-Ha anatomy. Tail and fin size/shape vary. Bioengineering Forms remain separate from baseline biology.

profiles.written_source: Toba-madra vAlpha.mht (newer owner source; supersedes gorilloid PDF visual origin)
profiles.visual_summary: Large anthropomorphic bear humanoid leaning slightly toward bear physiology: fur-covered, ursine muzzle/nose/ears, powerful upright body and visible bear tail.
special_customizer_behavior: older gorilloid PDF visual origin is superseded
actual cybernetics from installed augmentation projection; cosmetic tech plating separate
owner_canon_decisions: Newer owner source supersedes the older gorilloid concept: Toba-Madra are anthropomorphic bears leaning slightly toward bear physiology, upright/humanoid in limb use, fur-covered with ursine muzzle/nose/ears and a visible bear tail. Biological fur stays broadly within natural bear ranges; cosmetic dye may use any colors and patterns.
Visible cybernetics are projections of actual installed augmentations; cosmetic tech plating remains a separate presentation-only layer.

studio_profile_behavior.rule: actual cybernetics are equipment/augmentation projection; cosmetic plating remains presentation

profiles.visual_summary: Plant/tree humanoid with bark/woodgrain skin, plant-form hair, gemlike bioluminescent eyes and biological seasonal transformations.
bounded_variation: height under 5 ft to just over 6 ft
special_customizer_behavior: season is source-owned current biological state; appearance stores four linked seasonal custom profiles rather than deriving one generic recolor
owner_canon_decisions: Use the source range 'under 5 feet to just over 6 feet'. Players author four coordinated but separately customizable seasonal appearance profiles. Woodgrain/bark visibility ranges from barely visible to strongly tree-bark-like.

studio_profile_behavior.rule: four linked but separately customizable profiles; do not reduce to one recolor

profiles.visual_summary: Hyena-descended shapeshifter. Humanoid/base form remains visibly hyenic with fur, strong muzzle/head, mobile ears, digitigrade legs, tail and arcano-organic tattoos/markings.
bounded_variation: one or more source-authorized animal forms
special_customizer_behavior: hybrid form derives from authored base and animal identity rather than independent freeform customization
owner_canon_decisions: Normal humanoid form always retains the hyena-like head/muzzle, fur, mobile ears, digitigrade legs and tail shown by the concept direction; hybrid form is derived rather than independently authored.

studio_profile_behavior.rule: hybrid derives from authored identities and is not independently freeform

profiles.visual_summary: Bipedal chitin-armored species with helmet-like head plating, permanent combat claws containing retractable hands, and flexible segmented weapon tail.
special_customizer_behavior: acquired adaptation markers cannot be erased
active adaptation state changes live appearance automatically
hand deployed/folded is pose/live state
owner_canon_decisions: Acquired Adaptation markers are source-owned persistent biological history and cannot be erased in the appearance editor. Active Adaptations automatically update live appearance. Hands-extended versus hands-folded-inside-claws is live/pose state, not saved identity morphology.

studio_profile_behavior.rule: persistent markers cannot be erased; hand-in-claw state is live/pose

profiles.visual_summary: Pale gaunt Fell humanoid base with unsettling/necrotic presentation, followed by at most one irreversible ascension into Revenant, Sanguivore or Fragmentarii morphology.
required_features: base Nekron identity retained as derivation source
bounded_variation: Sanguivore: pale translucent organic body, shadow veins, elongated canines, blood-hued eyes
Fragmentarii: cracked/unraveling/translucent body with floating parchment-like flesh/memory strips
special_customizer_behavior: transition opens second customization opportunity constrained/derived from original; cannot freely switch among ascensions
owner_canon_decisions: Skeletal/Revenant, Vampiric/Sanguivore and Shardmind/Fragmentarii are distinct one-time ascension outcomes. A base Nekron may transition only once into one outcome and receives a second customization pass derived from the original appearance.

studio_profile_behavior.rule: appearance cannot trigger ascension or select an unavailable outcome

profiles.visual_summary: One game entity represented by a cohesive collective of visually identical small elderly humanoid constituents connected by psychic visual language.
special_customizer_behavior: design one constituent identity and replicate compositionally
lore count 17 is not a requirement to visibly render exactly 17 figures in every output
owner_canon_decisions: Constituent bodies are visually identical and think/act as one entity. Seventeen remains lore/source context rather than a renderer requirement to visibly place exactly seventeen figures; rendered composition should read as one cohesive collective.

studio_profile_behavior.renderer_behavior: repeat/cohere constituent appearance as one collective entity
studio_profile_behavior.rule: do not require exactly seventeen visible sprites

source_truth_invariants: Raw PDF/CSV source provenance remains preserved; PPIA-05 does not rewrite source to make biology cleaner or more complete.
Culture, society, belief, philosophy, profession, history and learned behavior are not immutable biology unless the source explicitly states a biological mechanism.
A Species perk can be biological, learned, cultural, mystical, technological or mixed; species eligibility alone is insufficient to classify physiology.
Environment-based perks and abilities are not biological Adaptations without explicit Species/Form/innate/body evidence.
The 2,203-row species/elementalist/innate dataset contains 260 Species Perks, 539 Innate Abilities and 1,404 Elementalist rows; dataset membership is insufficient to establish biology ownership.
The 57 Shapeshifter pricing-only rows cannot be automatically merged with the 60 detailed Ability rows by name, tier, position or similarity.
Same-name, shared-document, appearance, species label or narrative similarity is insufficient to create lineage, Form, compatibility or identity relationships.
Source fact, source absence, inference/recommendation, Character selection, runtime form state, temporary Effect/Condition state and Campaign environment remain distinguishable.
Unknown/source-unspecified anatomy remains unknown; no human/humanoid default is synthesized.
Current Form and persistent/active biological states are authoritative upstream projections, not editable cosmetics.
A valid Character remains valid when a renderer or view is partial/unsupported/unknown.
Hidden biological facts are filtered before appearance derivation, rendering, export and AI context.
Presentation wardrobe is nonmechanical and does not imply inventory/equipment ownership.
Actual equipment preview is a permission-safe projection only and never changes Asset state.
Randomization changes only eligible authored/cosmetic choices and never source-owned morphology/history/equipment.
Every visual state has semantic nonvisual representation; color is never the only state carrier.
